name: Crave — first sequenced note
notes: Start by making a simple, audible Crave sequence without patching. Only add external cables after the internal voice is confirmed. The Crave's own sequencer and app playback are two separate modes: use the device sequencer with MIDI clock, or stop it and play notes from this app.

controls.value: USB/MIDI only when clocking the Crave's own sequencer
Match the rear-panel DIP switches and Device Settings
Low to start, then raise gradually
Set a comfortable in-tune note before recording steps
Open enough to hear the oscillator
Start low to avoid harsh peaks
Set Sustain and Decay for a clear first note; adjust Release to taste

checklist.text: Connect the Crave over USB and verify it appears in the Device bar
Set Master Volume low, open Filter Cutoff, and lower Resonance
Set the VCO tune/range and confirm that the analog voice is audible before sequencing
Set App MIDI channel to match the rear-panel DIP switches
For app playback, stop the Crave sequencer and press the app Play control
For Clock mode, set Clock Source to USB/MIDI and use the device clock transport
